subject: English
passage: In 1885, John Pemberton created a new soft drink formula that would eventually become Coca-Cola. As Pemberton developed his beverage, he first mixed together various syrup ingredients in a large brass kettle. ______ he added carbonated water to create the fizzy texture. Lastly, he taste-tested the final product to ensure the flavor was balanced.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. "Next" logically signals that the action in this sentence—the adding of carbonated water—is the next step in the beverage creation process, following the syrup mixing mentioned in the previous sentence.
